title: Rosalind and the Confession
author: Noor Winterbourne
blurb: Orsen Thackeray, the archivist of a cathedral with a locked crypt, prides themselves on never taking a case they can't close. But when a body turns up dressed in clothes stolen from the witness's own closet, he discovers that staying invisible was never really an option. To get through this, he must trap a killer who knows the case file better than the investigators do before the trial begins.
style: vivid, cinematic prose with tight pacing
